scope: Proposition 4.5 of the manuscript “The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties” (preprints/The-rational-Hodge-conjecture-for-CM-abelian-varieties-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 032 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6e3e66a407773ad5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every finite input ϕ, the form Θi(ϕ) is holomorphic on D and descends to every sufficiently deep principal congruence quotient. At any fixed point of D, the values Θi(ϕ), as ϕ varies over finite Schwartz inputs, span the cotangent fiber. Finitely many actual inputs already span that fiber and descend at a common sufficiently deep principal level.
